description: Calls per ad campaign from the numbers configure_phone_number tagged with tracking: calls, answered, missed, minutes, distinct callers and, when a callValue was set, their value (callValue × answered calls), over the last `days` (default 30) or since a date. Each row carries the platform and campaign id it was tagged with, to join with that platform's ad report. Free. Needs Hermoso phone on (activate_phone_service) or Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).
name: call_tracking_report
title: Call tracking report
